name: deep-equal
title: Structural deep equality
prompt:
Replace the `JSON.stringify`-based `deepEqual(a, b)` in `deepEqual.js` (CommonJS export) with a real
structural comparison:
- primitives: `NaN` equals `NaN`, `+0` equals `-0`, no type coercion (`1` is not `"1"`)
- objects must have the same prototype (`[]` is not `{}`, a class instance is not a plain object)
- plain objects: same own enumerable keys (order does not matter); a key set to `undefined` is
  different from a missing key
- arrays: same length, element-wise; `Date`: same time; `RegExp`: same source and flags
- `Map`: same size, same keys (SameValueZero), deep-equal values; `Set`: same size and every element of
  one has a deep-equal element in the other
- cyclic structures must not overflow the stack
